62300.meaning1: in common; in conformity; in harmony (with)
62300.commentary: (MNa) sīlasāmaññagato viharatī'ti tesu tesu disābhāgesu viharantehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ samānabhāv'ūpagatasīlo viharati.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yāni tāni sīlāni akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni tathārūpesu sīlesu sīlasāmaññagato viharati sabrahmacārīhi āvi c'eva raho ca.
bhikkhu y'āyaṃ diṭṭhi ariyā niyyānikā niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya tathārūpāya diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhisāmaññagato viharati sabrahmacārīsu āvi c'eva raho ca

62301.meaning1: component of monkhood; factor of asceticism

examples.text: sīlavisuddhiṃ kho ahaṃ, sāḷha, aññataraṃ sāmaññ'aṅgan'ti vadāmi. ye te, sāḷha, samaṇabrāhmaṇā tapojigucchāvādā tapojigucchāsārā tapojigucchāallīnā viharanti, abhabbā te oghassa nittharaṇāya.
sukhā matteyyatā loke, atho petteyyatā sukhā, sukhā sāmaññatā loke, atho brahmaññatā sukhā.

62304.construction:
saṃ + ā + √ñā + ta + ā
sāmaññata + ā

62305.meaning1: goal of monkhood; purpose of renunciation; epithet of Nibbāna
62305.commentary: (MNa) katamo ca, bhikkhave, sāmaññ'attho? yo, bhikkhave, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sāmaññ'attho'ti

examples.text: ārocayāmi vo, bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo, bhikkhave, mā vo sāmaññ'atthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññ'attho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye
tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi gihibhogā ca parihīno, sāmaññ'atthañ'ca na paripūreti.

62306.meaning1: wanting (the heart of) monkhood; seeking (the essence of) asceticism

examples.text: ārocayāmi vo, bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo, bhikkhave, mā vo sāmaññ'atthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññ'attho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye

62307.meaning1: who accomplished (the purpose of) monkhood; (comm) who attained the peak of the ascetic state

examples.text: pakudhako kātiyāno nigaṇṭho, ye c'āp'ime makkhalipūraṇāse, gaṇassa satthāro sāmaññappattā, na hi nūna te sappurisehi dūre'ti.

62308.meaning1: fruit of monkhood; benefit of the spiritual life
62308.meaning2: fruit of the life of a recluse

examples.text: idam'pi kho, mahārāja, sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ purimehi sandiṭṭhikehi sāmaññaphalehi abhikkantatarañ'ca paṇītatarañ'ca.

62309.meaning1: question about the fruit of the spiritual life

62310.meaning1: nourishment of the fruit of the holy life

62311.meaningLit: discourse on the fruits of spiritual life

examples.text: tattha khandhā'ti pañc'upādānakkhandhā, te hi vipassan'upalakkhaṇato sāmaññalakkhaṇato ca ñātapariññ'ādīhi parijānanavasena vipassitabbā.

62314.meaning1: considered (the definition of) monkhood; reckoned as (fundamental to) ascetic life
62314.meaning2: considered (the definition of) monkhood; reckoned as (fundamental to) ascetic life

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ime'pi kho, āvuso gotama, tapopakkamā etesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sāmaññasaṅkhātā ca brahmaññasaṅkhātā ca.

62315.meaning1: produced by ethical restraint; (comm) generated by the rest of ethical conduct
62315.commentary: (SNa) ettha pana saccaṃ nāma saccavāditā. sāmaññaṃ nāma sesasīlaṃ.

examples.text: atha kho yāni tāni kulāni aḍḍhāni mahaddhanāni mahābhogāni pahūtajātarūparajatāni pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇāni pahūtadhanadhaññāni, sabbāni tāni dānasambhūtāni c'eva saccasambhūtāni ca sāmaññasambhūtāni ca. aṭṭha kho, gāmaṇi, hetū, aṭṭha paccayā kulānaṃ upaghātāya.

62318.meaning1: suitable for monasticism; in conformity with asceticism
62318.commentary: (ANa) sāmaññass'ānulomikā'ti samaṇadhammassa anulomā. (ITIa) sāmaññass'ānulomikā'ti samaṇadhammassa samathavipassanābhāvanāya ariyamaggass'eva vā anucchavikā appicchat'ādayo.

examples.text: ye c'assa dhammā akkhātā, sāmaññass'ānulomikā, adhiggahitā tuṭṭhassa, appamattassa sikkhato'ti.
atha kho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū taṃ sāmaṇakaṃ parikkhāraṃ ādāya nāvāya sahajātiṃ ujjaviṃsu
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā sikkhamānāya vā sāmaṇerassa vā sāmaṇeriyā vā sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ vikappetvā appaccuddhāraṇaṃ paribhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
atha kho āyasmato sāriputtassa etadahosi, bhagavatā paññattaṃ, na ekena dve sāmaṇerā upaṭṭhāpetabbā'ti.

62326.commentary: (KVt) kammaṃ karonte ārāmike pesan'atthāya dātabbā sammuti ārāmikapesakasammuti. esa nayo sāmaṇerapesakasammutī'ti etthā'pi.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena saṅghassa sāṭiyaggāhāpako na hoti… pattaggāhāpako na hoti… ārāmikapesako na hoti… sāmaṇerapesako na hoti. sāmaṇerā apesiyamānā kammaṃ na karonti.

62330.commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: bhikkhu bhikkhunī sikkhamānā, sāmaṇero atha sāmaṇerikā.
bhikkhu bhikkhunī sikkhamānā, sāmaṇero atha sāmaṇerikā, kassapassa vinayasmiṃ pabbajaṃ, pāpakammamakariṃsu tāva'd'e.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā sikkhamānāya vā sāmaṇerassa vā sāmaṇeriyā vā sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ vikappetvā appaccuddhāraṇaṃ paribhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
paribbājikā nāma bhikkhuniñ'ca sikkhamānañ'ca sāmaṇeriñ'ca ṭhapetvā yā kāci paribbājikasamāpannā.
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho sāmaṇḍako paribbājako āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca
atha kho sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako yen'āyasmā sāriputto ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.

62338.meaning1: near to; close to; neighbouring; bordering; in the vicinity of

examples.text: pharusavāco hoti. yā sā vācā aṇḍakā kakkasā parakaṭukā par'ābhisajjanī kodhasāmantā asamādhisaṃvattanikā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti

62340.meaning2: what is called talking making allusions

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, kulaputto uṭṭhānavīriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi puttadāradāsakammakaraporise [… sāmantasaṃvohāre] sakkaroti garuṃ karoti māneti pūjeti. tamenaṃ puttadāradāsakammakaraporisā sakkatā garukatā mānitā pūjitā kalyāṇena manasā anukampanti, ciraṃ jīva, dīghamāyuṃ pālehīti.

62343.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of sāmanta
62343.construction:
saṃ > sām + anta + *a + ā
sāmanta + ā
62343.commentary: (VIN 1.4.2.5) sāmantā sugatavidatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāyā'ti thirabhāvāya vaṭṭaṃ vā caturassaṃ vā chinditvā ekadese vā santharitabbaṃ vijaṭetvā vā santharitabbaṃ.

examples.text: nisīdanasanthataṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāya.
anādā ce bhikkhu purāṇasantha tassa sāmantā sugatavidatthiṃ, navaṃ nisīdanasanthataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

62344.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of sāmanta (+gen)
62344.meaning1: near (to); close (to); not far (from); in the neighbourhood (of)
62344.construction:
saṃ > sām + anta + *a + ā
sāmanta + ā

examples.text: mātugāmassa santike'ti mātugāmassa sāmantā, mātugāmassa avidūre.
atha kho so sattho tassa aggikassa jaṭilassa assamassa sāmantā ekarattiṃ vasitvā pakkāmi.

62345.meaning1: even oneself; just by oneself; even for oneself
62345.commentary: (SNa) sāmam'pi kho etan'ti taṃ taṃ pittavikāraṃ disvā attanā'pi etaṃ veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi kho, sīvaka, idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti. sāmam'pi kho etaṃ, sīvaka, veditabbaṃ yathā pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.

62347.commentary: (SNa) sāmayikaṃ cetovimuttin'ti appit'appitakkhaṇe paccanīkadhammehi vimuccati, ārammaṇe ca adhimuccatī'ti lokiyasamāpatti sāmayikā cetovimutti nāma. (SNPa) sāmayikaṃ vimuttin'ti lokiyasamāpattiṃ. sā hi appit'appitasamaye eva paccanīkehi vimuccanato sāmayikā vimuttī'ti vuccati. taṃ sāmayikaṃ vimuttiṃ. aṭṭhānaṃ taṃ, na taṃ kāraṇaṃ vijjati saṅgaṇikāratassa, yena kāraṇena phassaye'ti etaṃ ādiccabandhussa paccekabuddhassa vaco nisamma saṅgaṇikāratiṃ pahāya yoniso paṭipajjanto adhigato'mhī'ti āha.

examples.text: chaṭṭham'pi kho āyasmā godhiko tamhā sāmayikāya cetovimuttiyā parihāyi. sattamam'pi kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto sāmayikaṃ cetovimuttiṃ phusi.
aṭṭhānataṃ saṅgaṇikāratassa, yaṃ phassaye sāmayikaṃ vimuttiṃ, ādiccabandhussa vaco nisamma, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ iruvedaṃ yajuvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ athabbaṇavedaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ iti'h'āsaṃ purāṇaṃ nighaṇḍu keṭubhaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

62349.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of sa

examples.text: kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto sāmaṃ sen'āsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ eko adutiyo cārikaṃ pakkāmi
atisāradiṭṭhiyā'va so samatto, mānena matto paripuṇṇamānī, sayam'eva sāmaṃ manas'ābhisitto, diṭṭhī hi sā tassa tathā samattā.

62350.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of sa

examples.text: imam'atthaṃ bhagavā janavasabhassa yakkhassa sammukhā sutvā sammukhā paṭiggahetvā sāmañ'ca abhiññāya āyasmato ānandassa ārocesi, imam'attham'āyasmā ānando bhagavato sammukhā sutvā sammukhā paṭiggahetvā ārocesi bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ.
jānāsi taṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā'ti vā, dīghā vā rassā vā majjhimā vā kāḷī vā sāmā vā maṅguracchavī vā'ti, amukasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā nagare vā'ti?

62352.meaning2: kind of medical plant, brown creeper

62353.commentary: (DNa) sāmākabhakkho'ti sāmākataṇḍulabhakkho. (SNPa) sāmākā'ti dhunitvā vā sīsāni uccinitvā vā gayh'ūpagā tiṇadhaññajāti. (JAa) sāmākabhojanā'ti tiṇabījabhojana. sāmākaggahaṇena h'ettha sabbam'pi tiṇabījaṃ gahitaṃ.

examples.text: so sākabhakkho'pi hoti sāmākabhakkho'pi hoti nīvārabhakkho'pi hoti daddulabhakkho'pi hoti haṭabhakkho'pi hoti kaṇabhakkho'pi hoti ācāmabhakkho'pi hoti piññākabhakkho'pi hoti tiṇabhakkho'pi hoti gomayabhakkho'pi hoti, vanamūlaphal'āhāro'pi yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.
sāmākaciṅgūlakacīnakāni ca, pattapphalaṃ mūlaphalaṃ gavipphalaṃ, dhammena laddhaṃ satam'asnamānā, na kāmakāmā alikaṃ bhaṇanti.

so sākabhakkho'pi hoti sāmākabhakkho'pi hoti nīvārabhakkho'pi hoti daddulabhakkho'pi hoti haṭabhakkho'pi hoti kaṇabhakkho'pi hoti ācāmabhakkho'pi hoti piññākabhakkho'pi hoti tiṇabhakkho'pi hoti gomayabhakkho'pi hoti, vanamūlaphal'āhāro'pi yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.

te tattha sākabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, sāmākabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, nīvārabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, daddulabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, haṭabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, kaṇabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, ācāmabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, piññākabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, tiṇabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, gomayabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, vanamūlaphal'āhārā yāpesuṃ pavattaphalabhojī.

so vat'ānanda, bhikkhu saṅgaṇik'ārāmo saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇik'ārāmataṃ anuyutto gaṇ'ārāmo gaṇarato gaṇasammudito sāmāyikaṃ vā kantaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharissati asāmāyikaṃ vā akuppanti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

62359.meaning1: name of a female lay disciple; foremost laywoman among those living in a state of friendliness
62359.commentary: (ANa) bahussutānaṃ yadidaṃ, khujj'uttarā, mettāvihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ, sāmāvatī'ti bahussutānaṃ upāsikānaṃ khujj'uttarā, mettāvihārīnaṃ sāmāvatī aggā'ti dasseti. tā kira dve'pi padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatiyaṃ kulagehe paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhitvā aparabhāge satthu dhammakathaṃ sossāmā'ti vihāraṃ agamaṃsu. tattha, khujj'uttarā, satthāraṃ ekaṃ upāsikaṃ bahussutānaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. sāmāvatīpi ekaṃ upāsikaṃ mettāvihārīnaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. tāsaṃ dvinnam'pi yāvajīvaṃ kusalaṃ katvā devaloke nibbattitvā devamanussesu saṃsarantīnaṃ'y'eva kappasatasahassaṃ atikkantaṃ.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ mettāvihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ sāmāvatī.
candappabhāti sāmiatthe paccattaṃ, candappabhāyā'ti attho.

tam'enaṃ jano disvā evaṃ vadeyya, bhogī vata, bho, puriso, evaṃ kira bhogino bhogāni bhuñjantī'ti. tam'enaṃ sāmikā yattha yatth'eva passeyyuṃ tattha tatth'eva sāni hareyyuṃ. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, alaṃ nu kho tassa purisassa aññathattāyā'ti?
assāmikan'ti na añño koci sāmiko hoti, itthī vā puriso vā gahaṭṭho vā pabbajito vā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, vadhukā yaññad'eva rattiṃ vā divaṃ vā ānītā hoti, tāva'd'ev'assā tibbaṃ hir'ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sassuyā'pi sasure'pi sāmike'pi antamaso dāsakammakaraporisesu.
seṭṭhi, sace me dhītā vijāyissati, tāya naṃ saddhiṃ nivesetvā seṭṭhiṭṭhānassa sāmikaṃ karissāmi. sace me putto vijāyissati, māressāmi nan'ti cintetvā taṃ gehe kāresi.

62367.meaning1: fleshly; carnal; physical; worldly; of the flesh

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, vedanānaṃ vemattatā? atthi, bhikkhave, sāmisā sukhā vedanā, atthi nirāmisā sukhā vedanā, atthi sāmisā dukkhā vedanā, atthi nirāmisā dukkhā vedanā, atthi sāmisā adukkham'asukhā vedanā, atthi nirāmisā adukkham'asukhā vedanā.
sāmisaṃ vā sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti, nirāmisaṃ vā sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti.
na sāmisena hatthena pānīyathālakaṃ paṭiggahessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

62369.meaning1: carnal and spiritual; worldly and non-physical

62370.meaning1: variety of carnal and spiritual, etc.

examples.text: kissā'ti bhumm'atthe sāmivacanan'ti āha, kismiṃ abhirato'ti.
akāmakānan'ti anicchamānānaṃ, anādar'atthe sāmivacanaṃ.
puratthimāya disāya āgantvā sīghaṃ dūtayugaṃ taṃ dovārikaṃ evaṃ vadeyya, kahaṃ, bho purisa, imassa nagarassa nagarassāmī'ti? so evaṃ vadeyya, eso, bhante, majjhe siṅghāṭake nisinno'ti.

62374.commentary: (NIDD1a) lok'uttarassa dhammassa uppāditattā veneyy'ānurūpena yathāsukhaṃ lok'uttaradhammassa dānena ca dhammesu issaro'ti dhammassāmī. tathāgatapadaṃ heṭṭhā vuttatthaṃ.

examples.text: so h'āvuso, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto, vattā pavattā, atthassa ninnetā, amatassa dātā, dhammassāmī tathāgato.
sāmino hi, bhante, sāni harantī'ti. evam'eva kho, gahapati, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, yācitak'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti.

62378.meaning1: right way; correct course; proper procedure (for)

examples.text: ekena'pi ce ūno vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho taṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheyya, so ca bhikkhu anabbhito, te ca bhikkhū gārayhā, ayaṃ sāmīci.
tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, evaṃsamaññānaṃ sataṃ evaṃpaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ, yā samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadā taṃ paṭipajjissāma. evaṃ no ayaṃ amhākaṃ samaññā ca saccā bhavissati paṭiññā ca bhūtā.

62380.synonym: atthika, anucchavi, anucchavika, anurūpa, anulomika, dhammika, paṭirūpa, patirūpa, patirūpī, yuttaka, yuttarūpa, sāruppa

examples.text: yāni c'imāni, bhante, bhagavatā gihisāmīcikāni sikkhāpadāni desitāni, n'āhaṃ tesaṃ kiñci attani khaṇḍaṃ samanupassāmī'ti. lābhā te, gahapati, suladdhaṃ te, gahapati!

cattāro'me, mahārāja, vaṇṇā, khattiyā, brāhmaṇā, vessā, suddā. imesaṃ kho, mahārāja, catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ dve vaṇṇā aggam'akkhāyanti, khattiyā ca brāhmaṇā ca, yadidaṃ abhivādana-paccuṭṭhāna-añjalikamma-sāmīcikammānī'ti.

vassasat'ūpasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadah'upasampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.

62382.meaning1: respectful conduct and (providing) robes, alms food and accommodation

62383.meaning1: going the right way; following the proper course
62383.meaning2: going the right way; following the proper course; lit. gone along the correct way

62384.meaning1: going the right way; following the proper course

examples.text: yo kho, ānanda, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā upāsako vā upāsikā vā dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno viharati sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī so tathāgataṃ sakkaroti garuṃ karoti māneti pūjeti apaciyati paramāya pūjāya
na tāv'āhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti… dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipannā sāmīcippaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo

62385.construction:
saṃ > sām + ud + kaṃsa + a + *ika
samukkaṃsa + *ika
62385.commentary: (MNa) sāmukkaṃsikā'ti sāmaṃ ukkaṃsikā attanā'y'eva gahetvā uddharitvā gahitā, sayambhūñāṇena diṭṭhā, asādhāraṇā aññesan'ti attho. (ANa) sabbasāmukkaṃsikaṃ vata me'ti mayā sabbapucchānaṃ uttamapucchaṃ
62385.notes: The commentary suggests a compound, sāmaṃ ukkaṃsikā, 'elevated by oneself'.

examples.text: yadā bhagavā aññāsi brahm'āyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi, dukkhaṃ, samudayaṃ, nirodhaṃ, maggaṃ.

atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi, mā h'evaṃ kho uttiyo paribbājako pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭilabhi, sabbasāmukkaṃsikaṃ vata me samaṇo gotamo pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti, no vissajjeti, na nūna visahatī'ti.
ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando koliyesu viharati sāmugaṃ nāma koliyānaṃ nigamo.
atha kho sambahulā sāmugiyā koliyaputtā yen'āyasmā ānando ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabaddhāya vassamāsāni udake pariyādāya hem'antikena thalaṃ ukkhittāya vāt'ātapaparetāni vettabandhanāni.

62391.meaning1: evening; night; late in the day

examples.text: kesamassulocako'pi hoti kesamassulocan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, ubbhaṭṭhako'pi hoti āsanappaṭikkhitto, ukkuṭiko'pi hoti ukkuṭikappadhānam'anuyutto, kaṇṭak'āpassayiko'pi hoti kaṇṭak'āpassaye seyyaṃ kappeti, sāyatatiyakam'pi udak'orohan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.

tassa evaṃ hoti, mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā… yaṃ icchāma taṃ sāyāma, yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ sāyāma, yaṃ icchāma taṃ pivāma, yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ pivāma
